********************************************************************
*About "Angampora" 
-----------------------------
"Angampora" is the strategy or the martial art of traditional sinhalese which belongs to the philosophic warred category in the world.this martial art proudly owns a long term history in the world with the combination of "Marma" art , "Nila" art [confidential method in "HELA"(sinhalese)martial art , "Gata Welum"(locks),"Manthra Shasthra"(cryptocurrency works) and the traditional Sinhala medical practice. "Korathota Arachchi" generation can be considered as the foremost , greatest fighting generation in the era of "Seethawaka Kindom". The king "Seethawaka rajasingha" was chiefly supported by this "Korathota Arachchi" generation by terribly defeating the portuguese during the great war of "Mulleria"
